remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1917. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence and similarities to cat. nos. 117, 118, 120, 121. Completed in Virginia or Texas. Pictured in 1917 New York (291) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 11. Orientation based on Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence and Abiquiú Notebooks. Both sources indicate orientation differs from installation photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Blue I

description: At the center of the composition, a billowing blue shape spirals in on itself like the scroll of a violin. Dark and light blue lines curl around the shape like haloes and shadows.
